name: B10-0128/2024 (ECR) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to revise the rules on medical devices. It says these rules, in force since 2017, have caused shortages, delays and higher costs, especially for small companies. It wants simpler and faster approval, more support for small firms, longer validity for existing certificates, and protection of health data in health apps. This is a request, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks for simpler, faster approval of medical devices and longer validity of existing certificates.
- Patients, hospitals, manufacturers and small companies are affected by shortages and delays.
- The Commission is asked to act and report back; nothing changes automatically.
